> 14 page(s) of developer.paypal.com documentation — Braintree — Articles — Guides under Payment Methods. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Payment Methods

- [Venmo](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/payment-methods/venmo): Grow your business by tapping into the Venmo consumer base when you offer Venmo as a payment option at checkout.
- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/payment-methods/paypal/overview): With Braintree, you can seamlessly accept both PayPal and credit cards with a single integration.
- [ACH Direct Debit](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/payment-methods/ach): ACH, or Automated Clearing House, is a payment method that runs on banking networks in the United States.
- [Apple Pay](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/payment-methods/apple-pay): Apple Pay allows customers to make secure purchases using a credit or debit card associated with a supported Apple mobile device.
- [Google Pay](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/payment-methods/google-pay): Google Pay includes access to Google's payment method vault, allowing customers to quickly and securely make purchases on their Android mobile devices.
- [Secure Remote Commerce](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/payment-methods/secure-remote-commerce): Amex Express Checkout, Masterpass, and Visa Checkout have been replaced with the latest unified checkout experience offered through Visa known as Secure Remote Commerce (SRC).

- [Best Practices](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/payment-methods/paypal/best-practices): The new streamlined Pay with PayPal payment experience accelerates the buyer's checkout journey for every merchant use case!
- [Processing](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/payment-methods/paypal/processing): The streamlined Pay with PayPal payment experience accelerates the buyer's checkout journey for [One-Time…
- [Disputes](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/payment-methods/paypal/disputes): PayPal disputes can be managed in either your Braintree Control Panel or your PayPal Resolution Center.
- [Funding and Reconciliation](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/payment-methods/paypal/funding-reconciliation): Using PayPal **will not** affect your funding process for credit card transactions.
- [PayPal Pay Later Offers](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/payment-methods/paypal-pay-later-offers): PayPal offers short-term, interest-free payments, longer-term, monthly installments, and other special financing options that buyers can use to buy now and pay later, while…
- [Local Payment Methods](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/payment-methods/local-payment-methods): Local Payment Methods allow customers to pay with banks, wallets, or other means that operate only in specific regions of the world.
- [SEPA Direct Debit](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/payment-methods/sepa-direct-debit): SEPA Direct Debit is currently in limited release and is only available to pilot merchants. If you want to participate in the pilot, please
